A.depoimento: I have ordered the building of an archer in Lisboa. I am sending my knights to Santarem and spearmen to Evora to claim these villages, while keeping archers at home to protect the capital.
A.plano: Build 1 archer in Lisboa to utilize the iron. Send 3 knights to Santarem and 5 spearmen to Evora to capture both neutral villages. Keep 5 archers in Lisboa for defense.

B.depoimento: I split my forces to attack both neutral villages simultaneously, taking Tarragona with spearmen, archers, and a knight, and Girona with archers and knights. I also build two spearmen at my capital to start rebuilding my army.
B.plano: Capture both Tarragona and Girona to expand. Built 2 spearman at Barcelona. Next turn, explore new villages from these captures and decide where to expand next. Consider building more troops and sending them to capture Zaragoza or Huesca.

A.depoimento: I am expanding my realm! I have ordered more archers built and sent my forces to capture Badajoz and Faro. I am also reinforcing Santarem to prepare for the assault on Coimbra next turn. My armies march to victory!
A.plano: Build 2 archers in Lisboa. Send 2 knights to Badajoz, 4 spearmen to Faro, and 2 archers to Santarem. Next turn, send archers from Santarem to Coimbra. Keep 3 archers in Lisboa for defense. Do not send all troops away.

B.depoimento: We are launching a double offensive to secure Zaragoza and Huesca, opening up the northern and central routes. Barcelona's spearmen are marching to Tarragona to support the front lines, and a knight is being trained in the capital to ensure our continued growth.
B.plano: Attack Zaragoza with Tarragona's troops and Huesca with Girona's troops to expand our territory. Send Barcelona's spearman to Tarragona for reinforcement. Build a knight at Barcelona to strengthen our capital.

A.depoimento: I have consolidated my southern holdings by reinforcing Evora with spearmen from Faro. My main force from Santarem is marching on Coimbra to expand my territory, while my capital Lisboa produces a knight to bolster my military might.
A.plano: Build 1 knight in Lisboa, 1 archer in Santarem, and 1 archer in Evora. Send 2 archers and 1 knight from Santarem to attack Coimbra. Send 2 spearmen from Faro to Evora for reinforcement. Keep 5 archers in Lisboa and 1 knight in Badajoz for defense.

B.depoimento: Our forces strike! Huesca's army marches on Pamplona to expand our territory. Reinforcements flow: Barcelona sends a knight to Tarragona, and Tarragona sends spearmen to Zaragoza. We build new troops in our cities to prepare for the next pushes. The crown's power grows!
B.plano: Attack Pamplona with Huesca's full army to secure a new village. Send Barcelona's knight to Tarragona and Tarragona's spearmen to Zaragoza to reinforce our borders. Build a knight in Barcelona, an archer in Tarragona, and two spearmen in Girona to prepare for the next attacks on Castellon and Madrid.

A.depoimento: I launched an attack on Porto with my Coimbra garrison, hoping to capture the village and expand my territory. I also ordered reinforcements to Faro and Coimbra, and started a major build-up in my villages. I am eager to see the results of the Porto battle and continue my expansion westward.
A.plano: Next turn, verify the Porto attack succeeded. Begin moving troops from Porto towards Vigo and Burgos. Prepare the Sevilha attack from Faro. Continue building in all villages. Do not neglect capital defense. Watch for enemy counters.

B.depoimento: This turn, I am focusing on expanding southwards by attacking Castellon with Tarragona's garrison. I am also reinforcing Tarragona with Barcelona's knight to ensure our borders remain strong. On the production side, I am building an archer in Barcelona, knights in Tarragona and Girona, and spearmen in Zaragoza and Huesca to bolster our military strength for the upcoming campaigns.
B.plano: Attack Castellon with Tarragona's troops to secure a new village. Send Barcelona's knight to reinforce Tarragona. Build knights in Tarragona and Girona, archer in Barcelona, and spearmen in Zaragoza and Huesca to grow our army. Wait for the Huesca army to capture Pamplona and then consolidate our borders.

A.depoimento: I am focusing on building archers and consolidating my forces near the neutral villages. By moving troops to Coimbra and Badajoz, I will be able to launch successful attacks on Salamanca and Toledo next turn, expanding my territory and increasing my village count.
A.plano: Build archers in all villages except Porto. Move troops to Coimbra (from Porto, Santarem) and Badajoz (from Faro) to prepare for attacks on Salamanca and Toledo. Move Evora troops to Lisboa to defend capital. Next turn, attack Salamanca from Coimbra and Toledo from Badajoz.

B.depoimento: Our forces are on the move to consolidate our power. We are sending reinforcements to Pamplona and Castellon, and building up our armies in our cities. The neutral villages will soon fall to our might.
B.plano: We are building up our armies and moving troops to prepare for attacks on the neutral villages. Zaragoza's archer is marching to Pamplona to reinforce it for the attack on Burgos next turn. Zaragoza's spears are heading to Castellon to start the Valencia campaign. Tarragona's knights are moving to Zaragoza to form a strike force for Madrid. We are building knights in Zaragoza, Girona, Barcelona, archers in Tarragona, and spears in Huesca. Next turn, we will attack Burgos with overwhelming force and continue building for Madrid and Valencia.

A.depoimento: I have ordered a simultaneous assault on Salamanca and Toledo, leveraging the counter triangle to maximize my knight effectiveness. I have also moved archers from Evora, Santarem, and Faro to reinforce my capital and key forward bases. My forces are poised for expansion.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca and Toledo. Next turn, build troops in the new villages, reinforce Coimbra and Badajoz, and prepare to march on Madrid and Cordoba. Also consider sending spearmen to counter enemy knights in the north.

B.depoimento: I have launched attacks on Teruel and Burgos to expand my territory. My armies are marching to capture these neutral villages. I have also built up my forces and sent reinforcements to the front lines to prepare for the next phase of the campaign.
B.plano: Next turn, we will attack Valencia from Castellon and Madrid from Burgos. We will reinforce the newly captured Teruel and Burgos with surviving troops and new builds. Continue building knights in Zaragoza and Huesca, spears in other villages. Send Barcelona's troops forward via Tarragona. Watch for enemy movements and adjust plans accordingly.

A.depoimento: I am attacking Cordoba and Sevilha to expand my territory. I have left small defensive forces in Toledo and Badajoz. I am building up my army with spearman to counter enemy knights, and archers and knights for general strength. The enemy is engaged at Teruel, so I am focusing on the south.
A.plano: Toledo's archers and knight attack Cordoba. Badajoz's spearman, archer, and knight march to Sevilha. I build spearman in Lisboa, Badajoz, Faro, Porto to counter enemy knights; archers and knights in Santarem, Evora, Coimbra to maintain army. Leave 1 archer in Toledo and Badajoz for defense. Salamanca's knight stays for defense. Next turn: check Teruel result, build in Toledo and Cordoba (after capture), send new troops to reinforce, prepare for Vigo and Madrid attacks with more spearmen and knights.

B.depoimento: This turn we launch a double-pronged attack: Castellon strikes Valencia while Burgos marches on Madrid. We consolidate our interior by moving troops from Pamplona and Girona to reinforce the borders, and push Barcelona's army forward through Tarragona. Our economy continues to produce knights to sustain the campaign.
B.plano: Attack Valencia from Castellon and Madrid from Burgos to expand our territory. Send Barcelona's troops to Tarragona and reinforce Burgos from Pamplona, Girona to Barcelona. Build knights in all possible villages to maintain a strong mobile force. Watch for enemy counter-attacks on our new frontiers.

A.depoimento: We launched a pincer attack on Madrid, sending troops from Salamanca and Porto. We reinforced Porto for the upcoming assault on Vigo, and sent troops to Faro, Cordoba, and Toledo to prepare for further expansion. We built spearmen across our realm to strengthen our armies. Our armies are on the move to secure more villages.
A.plano: We attacked Madrid with troops from Salamanca and Porto to capture it quickly. We reinforced Porto from Coimbra and Santarem to prepare for an attack on Vigo. We sent troops from Evora to Faro and from Badajoz to Cordoba to build up forces for future attacks on Murcia and to reinforce Sevilha after its capture. We also sent Cordoba's troops to Toledo to bolster its defense. We built spearmen in most villages to counter enemy knights. Next turn: check results of Madrid and Sevilha battles, rebuild losses, and plan attacks on Vigo and Murcia. Watch for enemy counterattacks on Salamanca or Toledo

B.depoimento: I have moved the bulk of my army to the border villages of Madrid and Teruel, creating an impregnable wall. With these massive garrisons, I launch attacks on the enemy villages of Toledo and Salamanca. My industries are working overtime, producing knights and spearmen to fuel the expansion. The enemy cannot stop us now as we march towards victory.
B.plano: Reinforce Madrid and Teruel heavily to secure the borders against enemy counter-attacks. Attack Toledo and Salamanca to expand territory and eliminate enemy villages. Build knights in all wealthy villages to maintain a strong mobile force. Do not attack neutrals this turn as our troops are needed to consolidate the front.

A.depoimento: This turn I reinforced my borders and prepared for expansion. I moved Coimbra's troops to Porto and Salamanca, Badajoz's to Toledo, and Sevilha's to Cordoba. I built spearmen in all villages to counter enemy knights. Next turn I will attack Vigo and Murcia to capture neutral villages.
A.plano: Build spearmen everywhere. Next turn: attack Vigo from Porto (6 spearman, 3 archer, 1 knight) and Murcia from Cordoba (5 spearman, 2 archer, 1 knight). Reinforce Salamanca with Lisboa troops arriving. Watch for enemy counterattacks on Salamanca and Toledo. Explore unexplored villages after capturing neutrals.

B.depoimento: I have ordered a massive reinforcement of Madrid to repel the enemy's imminent attack. At the same time, my strike forces are marching to capture Salamanca and Toledo, turning the tide of the war. I will not let the enemy stand in my way!
B.plano: Reinforce Madrid with all available fast troops to hold against the enemy attack. Simultaneously strike Salamanca from Madrid and Toledo from Teruel to capture these enemy villages and expand my territory. Build troops in all villages to replenish losses and prepare for the next wave of expansion. Do not attack neutral villages yet; focus on consolidating the front.

B.depoimento: This turn, we strike at Badajoz! Our armies are on the march to conquer this enemy village and expand our territory. We are also strengthening our borders to ensure the enemy cannot push us back. Our forges are burning day and night as we build new units to feed the war.
B.plano: We are launching a major assault on Badajoz from Toledo, supported by a follow-up force from Madrid. We are reinforcing Toledo heavily from our nearby villages to defend against enemy counterattacks. We are building troops across all our villages to maintain our war machine. We must secure Badajoz to bring us closer to victory.

A.depoimento: Sevilha was vulnerable, so I sent a small force from Faro to reinforce it and started building a garrison there. I am also expanding my military production across all my villages to prepare for the next phase of the campaign.
A.plano: Reinforce Sevilha with 2 spear, 1 arch from Faro to secure the border. Build 4 spearman in Sevilha and troops in all other villages to grow my army. Monitor enemy movements towards Toledo and Badajoz, and prepare to counter any attacks on my border villages.

B.depoimento: King B orders the attack on Salamanca with a knightly charge, while reinforcing Badajoz and building a mighty host of knights across the realm. Our armies begin their march south to gather for the next assaults.
B.plano: We are launching a major assault on Salamanca with 5 knights from Madrid, expecting to use the counter bonus against their archers. We are reinforcing Badajoz with a knight and spearmen from Toledo to secure our southern border. We are building knights across most of our villages to grow our army, and we are moving northern troops south to prepare for the next attacks on Sevilha and Santarem. We must hold our newly built troops for the next turn's offensives. Do not attack Sevilha this turn; we need to keep Badajoz defended.

A.depoimento: This turn, I focused on strengthening my defenses along the border with King B. I sent reinforcements to Salamanca, Santarem, Faro, and Sevilha to protect against enemy assaults. I also launched an attack on the neutral village of Vigo, sending a strong force from Porto to expand my territory. My villages are producing more troops, and I am ready to strike again next turn.
A.plano: Reinforced border villages: sent troops from Coimbra to Salamanca, Lisboa to Santarem, Evora to Faro, and Cordoba to Sevilha. Attacked Vigo from Porto to gain a new village. Next turn, assess the battle results and continue building troops. Prepare to attack Murcia from Cordoba once we have enough forces. Monitor enemy attacks on Sevilha and Salamanca; our reinforcements should hold.

B.depoimento: Our armies are on the move! Valencia takes Murcia, Burgos takes Vigo, and Badajoz assaults Santarem. Reinforcements are flowing to the borders. Next turn, we strike at Salamanca and Sevilha!
B.plano: We are attacking Murcia, Vigo, and Santarem this turn to expand our territory. Reinforcements are marching to Badajoz and Madrid to prepare for next turn's attacks on Salamanca and Sevilha. We must hold our new villages and continue building troops.

A.depoimento: This turn we focused on reinforcing our borders and preparing for major attacks. We sent troops to strengthen Vigo, Faro, Santarem, Porto, and Cordoba, while Cordoba's army marched on Murcia. Our builders worked tirelessly, producing knights and archers to swell our ranks. Next, we shall claim Murcia and then turn our eyes to Badajoz and Burgos.
A.plano: Built knights in most villages and archers in Cordoba. Sent troops from Cordoba to attack Murcia; from Porto to reinforce Vigo; from Evora to reinforce Faro; from Coimbra to reinforce Porto; from Lisboa to reinforce Santarem; from Sevilha to reinforce Cordoba. Next turn, take Murcia, then attack Badajoz from Faro and Burgos from Vigo. Continue building troops and consider attacking Toledo from Santarem after taking Badajoz.

B.depoimento: I have ordered a strong assault on Salamanca from Madrid, sending 18 troops to conquer it. I have also sent reinforcements to Burgos from Madrid and Pamplona to prepare for the attack on Vigo next turn. Additionally, I am shifting my eastern armies toward the central front to reinforce my positions. These moves aim to secure Salamanca and Vigo quickly to reach the 18-village threshold.
B.plano: Attack Salamanca with full force from Madrid. Reinforcements sent to Burgos to prepare for Vigo attack next turn. Troops from east moved to Madrid and center. Next turn: attack Vigo from Burgos, continue building for Cordoba. Watch for enemy reactions and reinforce Salamanca garrison.

A.depoimento: I have ordered a massive offensive on Badajoz, sending the full garrisons of Faro and Salamanca to assault the enemy hub. At the same time, I am reinforcing my key border villages—Sevilha and Evora to Faro, Lisboa to Santarem, and Cordoba to Murcia—to prepare for the next wave of expansions, aiming to capture Valencia and push towards the enemy capital. My blacksmiths are working overtime, building knights and archers in every village to sustain our military might.
A.plano: Attack Badajoz from Faro and Salamanca this turn to secure the southern border and expand. Reinforce Faro with Sevilha and Evora, Santarem with Lisboa, Murcia with Cordoba, and Vigo with Porto/Coimbra. Focus on capturing Valencia next turn once reinforced. Build knights in all major villages to maintain momentum.

B.depoimento: Ordered a coordinated three-pronged assault on Salamanca, Vigo, and Sevilha to expand our territory and weaken King A's holdings. Sent reinforcements to Toledo and Valencia to set up the next attacks on Cordoba and Murcia. Split Zaragoza's versatile forces to strengthen Madrid and the southern approach. Built knights across the realm to replenish our ranks and prepare for the final push to 18 villages.
B.plano: Launch simultaneous attacks on Salamanca (from Madrid), Vigo (from Burgos), and Sevilha (from Badajoz) to break the enemy border. Reinforce Toledo with Teruel's spearmen to prepare for the Cordoba attack, and Valencia with Castellon's spearmen to prepare for Murcia. Split Zaragoza's troops: send the archer and knights to Madrid for future operations, and the spearmen to Teruel to reinforce the southern route. Build a knight in every village to replenish the army after the attacks.

A.depoimento: I launched attacks on Burgos and Valencia, sending all available troops from Vigo and Murcia. I reinforced Badajoz with Santarem's forces and sent a detachment to Sevilha to hold the line against the enemy's march. I built knights and archers across my villages to prepare for the next wave of expansions.
A.plano: Capture Burgos from Vigo and Valencia from Murcia this turn. Reinforce Badajoz with Santarem's troops to prepare for the Salamanca attack next turn when the marching troops arrive. Send a small force from Badajoz to Sevilha to defend against the enemy army. Build knights and archers in all villages to increase troop count.

B.depoimento: We have launched attacks on Cordoba and Porto to expand our territory, and we are reinforcing Burgos to secure our northern border. Knights are streaming into Valencia to prepare for an assault on Murcia. Our army on the march should capture Sevilha this turn, adding another village to our domain.
B.plano: Build spearmen in every village to replenish our ranks. This turn we attack Cordoba from Toledo and Porto from Salamanca, while sending heavy reinforcements to Burgos from Madrid and Pamplona. Knights are dispatched to Valencia to build up our force for the coming assault on Murcia. Next turn we will check the result of the Sevilha march and plan the capture of Coimbra.

A.depoimento: This turn, I am consolidating my power by reinforcing my strongest army in Badajoz with elite troops from Santarem. I am launching coordinated attacks on the weaker enemy outposts of Porto and Cordoba to expand my territory and secure resources. My main force is striking Salamanca to break through King B's defenses. I am also focusing on building knights and archers across my villages to ensure a steady flow of high-quality troops for the campaigns ahead.
A.plano: Focus on capturing Porto, Cordoba, and Salamanca this turn. Reinforce Badajoz with Santarem's troops to prepare for the next push into Toledo or Sevilha. Build knights and archers in all villages to maintain troop production. Ignore the previous order to attack Burgos and Valencia as our forces are too weak; we must build up first.

B.depoimento: This turn, our armies strike at Murcia, Vigo, and Coimbra simultaneously to secure the 18 villages needed for victory. We are sending all available troops from Valencia, Burgos, and Salamanca to overwhelm the enemy defenses. At the same time, we are dispatching reinforcements from Madrid, Pamplona, Teruel, Castellon, and Porto to our border villages to prepare for the next phase of the campaign. We are also building 2 spearmen in every village to ensure our ranks remain strong.
B.plano: We are launching a three-pronged attack this turn to capture Murcia, Vigo, and Coimbra, which will bring our total to 19 villages. Valencia, Burgos, and Salamanca are sending all their troops to attack. Simultaneously, we are sending reinforcements from Madrid, Pamplona, Teruel, Castellon, and Porto to Burgos, Valencia, and Salamanca to prepare for next turn's defense and further expansion. We are building 2 spearmen in every village to replenish our ranks.

A.depoimento: This turn, we focused on reinforcing Coimbra to hold off the enemy's counter-offensive, while launching a major assault on Toledo with our main force from Badajoz. We also sent reinforcements from Faro to secure Badajoz. Our troops are building up across all villages to ensure we have a steady stream of knights and archers for the campaigns ahead.
A.plano: We must defend Coimbra from the incoming enemy army by sending all available knights from Lisboa, Santarem, and Porto. Meanwhile, push the offensive by sending Badajoz's large army to attack Toledo, which is vulnerable. Reinforce Badajoz with troops from Faro to secure the border after the attack. Continue building knights and archers in all villages to maintain our war machine.

B.depoimento: We are attacking Coimbra and Porto this turn to expand our empire to 19 villages. Salamanca is fortified and ready to repel the incoming enemy assault. Our villages are producing 2 spearmen each to ensure our military dominance.
B.plano: Capture Coimbra and Porto to reach 19 villages. Defend Salamanca by keeping its troops and reinforcing from Madrid. Send Vigo's army to attack Porto, and reinforce Vigo with 2 spearmen from Burgos. Build 2 spearmen in all villages to grow our forces.

A.depoimento: We launched a double offensive on the weak enemy borders, sending troops from Salamanca to Madrid and from Toledo to Cordoba, while leaving strong defensive garrisons behind to protect our newly conquered lands. We also reinforced Santarem with a knight from Lisboa and built up our archer forces to prepare for the assault on Coimbra next turn. Our war machine is rolling forward.
A.plano: Attack Madrid and Cordoba with Salamanca and Toledo troops, leaving enough defenders to secure the borders. Reinforce Santarem with the knight from Lisboa and build archers to prepare the assault on Coimbra next turn. Continue building knights in all villages to maintain momentum.

B.depoimento: I have conquered Coimbra and Porto, but lost Salamanca and Toledo. Now I will take Santarem to reach 18 villages and secure the border. I am reinforcing Madrid, Coimbra, Teruel, and Cordoba to hold the line.
B.plano: Conquer Santarem to reach 18 villages and secure the win condition. Reinforce Madrid, Coimbra, Teruel, and Cordoba to defend against enemy counterattacks. Build 2 spearmen in all villages to grow our forces.
